issues: 飞行卡的起点 y=210 与面板里真实行槽（≈238）错位约 28px，起飞瞬间可见跳变；飞出的行里复选框变成黑方块、没有勾
面板只有 3 行，下方 2/3 是空白；全部内容是灰色骨架条，读不出是什么内容被搬上画布
飞行全程阴影固定、无高度变化，快速段没有运动模糊，落位像平移贴图
光标沿直线斜穿画面；按钮 2px 灰边面板上的深灰块，按下只有缩放
背景平灰 + 均匀点阵，画布没有任何"这是白板"的线索
changes: 行槽改为绝对定位并与飞行起点共用 ROWS_TOP=262 常量，起飞零跳变；面板行与飞行行共用同一 RowContent 组件（含已勾选复选框）
面板做成 6 行"Research notes"列表，勾选不连续的 3 行（0/2/3），行含标题、标签胶囊、头像；飞出后槽位留虚线 + "On canvas" 提示
卡形态换成出版级研究笔记卡（标签点、计数、26px 标题、摘要、作者），按 480×240 终态排版随卡长大逐步露出，交叉淡化窗口保持 0.45
飞行段离地高度随弧线 sin 抬升（softShadow 2→48→6）+ 中段放大 3.5% + 按速度的方向性运动模糊（velocity 驱动，落定归零）
按钮改为深色渐变 + 计数徽章随打勾 1→2→3 弹跳，按下带裁进圆角的涟漪；光标走上拱弧线 + swift 缓动，停在徽章右侧不挡字；加画布工具条与柔光底
issuesEn: Flying cards start at y=210 while the real row slots sit at about 238, so each card jumps ~28px at takeoff; the flying row also shows a black square instead of a checked box
The panel holds only 3 rows with the bottom two-thirds empty, and all content is grey skeleton bars, so you can't tell what is being moved to the canvas
Shadow stays constant during flight with no sense of height and no motion blur in the fast part, so landing reads as a sliding decal
The cursor travels in a straight diagonal; the button is a dark grey block on a 2px grey-bordered panel and only scales when pressed
Flat grey background with a uniform dot grid and no hint that the left side is a whiteboard
changesEn: Row slots are absolutely positioned from the same ROWS_TOP=262 constant as the flight origin, so takeoff has zero jump; panel rows and flying rows share one RowContent component (with the checked box)
Panel is now a 6-row "Research notes" list with 3 non-adjacent rows picked (0/2/3), each with title, tag pill and avatar; vacated slots become dashed outlines with an "On canvas" hint
Card state is a publication-grade research note (tag dot, count, 26px title, excerpt, author) laid out at the final 480×240 and revealed as the card grows; the crossfade window stays at 0.45
Flight height follows the arc (softShadow 2→48→6) with a 3.5% mid-flight scale and velocity-driven directional motion blur that goes to zero on landing

Button is a dark gradient with a count badge that pops 1→2→3 as rows are checked and a ripple clipped to its corners on press; the cursor follows an arched swift-eased path and stops right of the badge; added a board toolbar and soft-lit canvas
